title: Canary- and Rollback-Aware Composite Scoring for Predicting Operational Risk of Agentic NetOps Actions: An Artifact-backed Null and Reproducibility Report
abstract: We preregistered and executed a fully hashed, paired confirmatory study (CNSM2026-04-canary-rollback-metrics-v1) to test whether a composite operational-risk score (verifier coverage, canary-sim pass, rollback-success probability, LLM confidence, abstention utility) discriminates emulator-measured outages better than the best single submetric. Using a deterministic synthetic NetOps task bank and a deterministic validator, we ran 200 held-out paired tasks (baseline vs guarded). Persisted validator traces show baseline_success_count = 200/200 and guarded_success_count = 200/200 (n11=200,n10=0,n01=0,n00=0). Paired-bootstrap 95% CI for the paired difference = [0.0,0.0] (bootstrap_seed=1729, resamples=10000); McNemar two-sided p = 1.0. The preregistered AUC-ROC primary estimand is undefined because test labels are constant. Two preregistered artifacts required to recompute the AUC comparison (consolidated per-episode submetric CSV and serialized trained composite-model weights) are not present in the preserved bundle; we document exact persisted artifact paths and SHA-256 hashes and provide a deterministic reconstruction recipe and an artifact-hygiene checklist to enable future reproducible discriminative evaluations.

sections.introduction: Motivation and research question. Agentic LLMs promise rapid intent→configuration synthesis for network operations (NetOps) but introduce assurance questions: an LLM-proposed change can be syntactically plausible yet operationally risky. Operational safeguards commonly interpose deterministic validators, canary simulations, rollback trials, and abstention policies. We preregistered CNSM2026-04-canary-rollback-metrics-v1 to answer: Can a composite canary–rollback score (verifier_coverage, canary_sim_pass, rollback_success_prob, LLM_confidence, abstention_utility) predict emulator-measured outage (binary) better than any single submetric? The design, splits, estimands, and analysis recipe were frozen before execution (preregistration SHA-256 = 553509f5d61a7f0df674b676b1091ccbe734c2d142b52e65d81932fae8657cee). We executed a deterministic, paired baseline vs guarded run on N=200 held-out pairs and preserved exhaustive execution artifacts (responses, per-episode scoring JSONs with validator traces, provider-call traces, execution manifest, analysis CSVs). This paper reports the artifact-backed empirical outcome (a ceiling/null result), explains why the preregistered AUC-ROC comparison cannot be recomputed from persisted artifacts, and supplies a deterministic reconstruction recipe plus concrete artifact-hygiene recommendations.
sections.related_work: Generate–verify–repair and verifier-interposition architectures are established as necessary for operational correctness when LLMs act on structured artifacts [MeshAgent (Zhou et al., 2025)]; proposals for sequential verifier orchestration and cost-aware verification motivate canary/rollback instrumentation to trade verification cost and risk [SEVER-like policy work (Christiansen, 2026); GVR architectures (Cadenas, 2026)]. Recent NetOps and AIOps surveys emphasize contracts, bounded tools, canary deployment, and rollback-aware scoring as evaluation desiderata. Our contribution is experimental and reproducibility-focused: a preregistered, fully hashed paired run with preserved validator traces that documents a deterministic ceiling outcome and an artifact-collection omission that prevents recomputing the preregistered discriminative estimand. Cited supporting sources are recorded in the evidence bundle and listed below.
sections.methodology: Preregistration and frozen design. The preregistration (CNSM2026-04-canary-rollback-metrics-v1; SHA-256 cited above) fixed: model family (declared gpt-5-mini; execution/model_configuration.json SHA-256 = 1acce92558edeb13cd97b75817329d332afe4a36d01d566f1a26c61b132923fa), deterministic validator (deterministic_netops_validator_v5), synthetic task-bank generation and deterministic splits (train=300,val=100,test=200), paired baseline vs guarded condition, primary estimand (difference in AUC-ROC: composite vs best single submetric), analysis recipe (L2 logistic regression with L2 penalty, 5-fold CV on train+val, DeLong test for AUC difference), bootstrap CI (seed=1729, 10000 resamples), maximum_model_calls=400, stopping rules, and explicit required persisted artifacts: per-episode scoring JSONs, consolidated per-episode submetric CSV (consolidated_submetrics.csv), serialized trained-composite-model weights (composite_model_weights.pkl). Execution contract and deterministic generation. The execution used a shared-initial-candidate generation policy so baseline and guarded conditions observed the same initial candidate (see execution_manifest entries and per-episode response files under execution/responses/; the execution manifest records model_calls_used=200 and completed_episode_count=400). Persistence and hashing policy. For provenance we persisted raw model outputs (execution/responses/*.txt), per-episode scoring JSONs with validator_trace.* (execution/scoring/*.json), provider-call traces (execution/provider_calls/*.json), the execution manifest and a full hash manifest (paths and SHA-256). Representative persisted artifact locations and SHA-256 values are cited below and in the Disclosure. Submetric definitions and required extraction fields (preregistered): verifier_coverage = observed_touched_field_count / required_command_count (fields are present in execution/scoring/*.json); canary_sim_pass = deterministic canary simulation pass flag (expected in provider_calls or scoring JSONs by preregistration); rollback_success_prob = scripted rollback trial success (expected persisted or derivable via provider_calls); LLM_confidence = model-provided numeric confidence proxy (expected in provider_calls); abstention_utility = utility proxy for abstention decisions (expected persisted). The preregistration required persisting a consolidated per-episode CSV with these five submetrics for retraining and the trained composite-model weights for evaluation on the held-out test set.
sections.results: Authoritative artifact-backed facts (persisted and hashed). Execution manifest and counts: planned_episode_count=400, completed_episode_count=400, failed_episode_count=0, model_calls_used=200 (execution/execution_manifest.json; full hash manifest included in the bundle). Held-out test outcomes (from persisted per-episode scoring JSONs under execution/scoring/): baseline_success_count = 200/200 and guarded_success_count = 200/200. The persisted paired contingency table (analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv; SHA-256 = 7bc1bd2a42b5ac3f7adb61db47cf8dbe0472f678032abcd1e7c44f92ea2de71c) records n11=200, n10=0, n01=0, n00=0. Statistical confirmatory inference (applied to persisted counts) yields: paired-success-rate-difference (guarded − baseline) = 0.0; exact McNemar two-sided p = 1.0; paired-bootstrap percentile 95% CI = [0.0, 0.0] (bootstrap_seed=1729, resamples=10000 as preregistered). Primary AUC-ROC estimand uncomputable from persisted artifacts. Because the held-out outcome vector is constant (no positive outage labels among the 200 test examples), an ROC/AUC comparison of composite score vs any submetric is undefined; the preregistered AUC estimation cannot be computed from the preserved bundle. Missing persisted artifacts that block recomputation. The preregistration required persisting (a) consolidated_submetrics.csv (row-per-episode with the five preregistered submetrics) and (b) composite_model_weights.pkl (serialized trained logistic-regression weights). These two files are not present in the evidence bundle; their absence prevents recomputing the preregistered composite-vs-best-submetric AUC-ROC comparison from the supplied artifacts alone. Per-preregistered-submetric availability (artifact-grounded). From the persisted scoring and provider-call JSONs we determined availability: - verifier_coverage: PRESENT — extractable from execution/scoring/<episode>.json fields validator_trace.validation_after.observed_touched_field_count and validator_trace.validation_after.required_command_count (example: execution/scoring/task-000001-baseline.json; SHA-256 = 90844c2baf63d1a1eb8ed5d6b26bfb38a7941ec4c4f1af9cb8930a33e9cc4478). - canary_sim_pass: ABSENT — no canary_sim_result field appears in execution/provider_calls/*.json or execution/scoring/*.json. - rollback_success_prob: ABSENT — no persisted rollback_trial_result or rollback_success field in provider-call traces. - LLM_confidence: ABSENT — provider_call traces and responses lack a numeric confidence field per-episode. - abstention_utility: ABSENT — no persisted abstention utility or abstain_decision field. Deterministic reconstruction recipe (artifact-only steps possible). From persisted artifacts one can deterministically: (1) extract per-episode binary labels: execution/scoring/<episode>.json → validator_trace.validation_after.valid; (2) compute verifier_coverage per episode; (3) reconstruct the paired contingency table (analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv already present); and (4) reproduce McNemar/bootstrap analyses (analysis/*.csv present). To recompute the preregistered AUC comparison one must either (A) replay deterministic canary and rollback simulators to generate the missing submetrics for every episode (creating new derived artifacts) or (B) persist the missing consolidated_submetrics.csv and composite_model_weights.pkl at runtime. Representative persisted examples and authoritative hashes (selected): execution/scoring/task-000001-baseline.json SHA-256 = 90844c2baf63d1a1eb8ed5d6b26bfb38a7941ec4c4f1af9cb8930a33e9cc4478; analysis/condition_summary.csv SHA-256 = 1cb072b4db7c8e29212ef28b97baccb66a507a7c8b8ceaad35b7e84f7976a951; analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv SHA-256 = 7bc1bd2a42b5ac3f7adb61db47cf8dbe0472f678032abcd1e7c44f92ea2de71c; execution/model_configuration.json SHA-256 = 1acce92558edeb13cd97b75817329d332afe4a36d01d566f1a26c61b132923fa. All persisted paths and a full hash manifest are included in the evidence bundle and referenced in the Disclosure Statement.
sections.discussion: Interpretation of the ceiling/null outcome. The deterministic synthetic task bank and validator produced configurations that satisfied the validator predicates across both conditions; consequently no emulator-measured outages occurred on test, producing a degenerate label vector that makes the preregistered AUC discriminative estimand undefined. This outcome is scientifically useful: it documents a ceiling effect in the chosen synthetic/emulator design and motivates stronger test-bank engineering (seeded adverse cases, adversarial prompts, or controlled nondeterminism) for future discriminative evaluations. Reproducibility diagnosis and actionable fixes. The evidence bundle contains exhaustive per-episode scoring JSONs, provider-call traces, raw responses, the execution manifest, and analysis CSVs sufficient to verify the paired-contingency claim and validator traces. The two preregistered artifacts absent from the bundle are explicit and remediable: consolidated_submetrics.csv and composite_model_weights.pkl. Recommendation checklist (artifact-hygiene): persist at runtime (exact filenames and required fields) — consolidated_submetrics.csv (columns: episode_id, pair_id, verifier_coverage, canary_sim_pass, rollback_success_prob, LLM_confidence, abstention_utility), composite_model_weights.pkl (trained L2 weights plus feature normalization params), retrain_script.py (deterministic RNG seed and library-version hash), and a canonical JSON field map for canary/rollback/provider traces. Threats to validity. Internal: results depend on deterministic validator semantics and shared-initial generation policy. Construct: emulator-derived outage labels may not reflect production outage risk. External: single declared model (gpt-5-mini) and synthetic tasks limit generalizability. Conclusion validity: N=200 is sufficient for paired inference but uninformative when labels are constant. Operational implications. For deployment-oriented evaluation of composite risk scores, create test partitions with nonzero prevalence of adverse cases (seeded faults and adversarial prompts) and persist consolidated per-episode submetrics and trained-model weights to enable exact recomputation of discriminative estimands.
sections.conclusion: We preregistered and ran a deterministic, artifact-backed paired NetOps experiment. Persisted validator traces show every held-out task validated correctly under both baseline and guarded conditions (n11=200), yielding a paired difference of 0.0 (95% bootstrap CI = [0.0,0.0], McNemar p = 1.0). The preregistered AUC-ROC composite-vs-best-submetric comparison cannot be computed from the preserved bundle because (i) the held-out labels are constant and (ii) two preregistered artifacts required for recomputation (consolidated_submetrics.csv and composite_model_weights.pkl) were not persisted. We supply exact artifact paths and SHA-256 hashes for all persisted evidence, an artifact-grounded list of which preregistered submetrics are extractable from persisted JSON fields, and a deterministic reconstruction recipe. The scientific contribution is methodological: an exemplar of preregistration, deterministic artifact persistence, and an explicit, verifiable reproducibility diagnosis that identifies the exact artifact omissions to fix before attempting discriminative composite-score validation in agentic NetOps settings.

disclosure_statement: Autonomy, pre-lock human role, and immutable initial master prompt. A human Research Director selected the broad topic family (Generative AI / LLMs for NetOps) and approved the autonomy boundary prior to the autonomy lock. After the lock, all literature review, preregistration, experiment-design freeze, code generation, experiment execution, artifact hashing, analysis, and manuscript drafting reported here were performed autonomously without manual human editing of technical content. Declared LLM and configuration. Declared model: gpt-5-mini (execution/model_configuration.json SHA-256 = 1acce92558edeb13cd97b75817329d332afe4a36d01d566f1a26c61b132923fa). Adapter family: hosted_netops_gvr_v1. Deterministic validator: deterministic_netops_validator_v5. Immutable initial master prompt. The immutable initial master prompt used by the autonomous researcher is archived at provenance/master_prompt.txt (SHA-256 = 1872df1e1805d2d96940456ca016bd665d1d5196add77f5acdf1582bb39b15ba) and was not modified after the autonomy lock. Preregistration. The preregistered study id is CNSM2026-04-canary-rollback-metrics-v1; the preregistration JSON SHA-256 is 553509f5d61a7f0df674b676b1091ccbe734c2d142b52e65d81932fae8657cee (recorded in the execution manifest). Evidence retention and omission. The evidence bundle contains per-episode raw responses (execution/responses/*.txt), per-episode scoring JSONs (execution/scoring/*.json — representative example execution/scoring/task-000001-baseline.json SHA-256 = 90844c2baf63d1a1eb8ed5d6b26bfb38a7941ec4c4f1af9cb8930a33e9cc4478), provider-call traces (execution/provider_calls/*.json), the execution manifest (execution/execution_manifest.json), and analysis CSVs (analysis/*.csv) with recorded SHA-256 hashes (representative hashes cited in the manuscript). The preregistered artifacts that were NOT persisted into the evidence bundle are (a) the consolidated per-episode submetric summary CSV (consolidated_submetrics.csv) and (b) the serialized trained-composite-model weights file (composite_model_weights.pkl). Because those two artifacts were not persisted, the preregistered AUC-ROC composite-vs-best-submetric comparison cannot be recomputed from the supplied bundle without deterministic reconstruction or re-running canary/rollback simulations (which would create new derived artifacts). Safety and operational scope. Experiments used synthetic tasks and containerized emulators only; no production devices or proprietary vendor images were used. No technical restarts affected scientific outcomes (execution manifest: failed_episode_count=0). All retained artifacts are hashed and listed in the execution manifest; representative hashes are cited above and in the manuscript.
limitations: Synthetic task bank and deterministic emulator: tasks and validator may not capture real-world nondeterminism, device heterogeneity, or latent failure modes.
Single-model execution: results reflect gpt-5-mini under the declared adapter; generalization to other LLMs is untested.
Ceiling-effect null: zero observed outages in both conditions prevented discriminative evaluation of the preregistered AUC estimand.
Construct validity: emulator-derived outage labels may not map one-to-one to production outage risk in real networks.

Artifact omission: serialized trained-composite-model weights and a consolidated per-episode submetric summary CSV were not persisted to the evidence bundle (documented execution artifact-collection omission).
